requirements.businessContext: The Captains & Chips module owns the SUBMISSION lifecycle for the two strategic levers a TVT/Triple-Crown team controls each gameweek: (1) declaring which player on their 2-man team is the captain (whose net score is doubled by the scoring engine), and (2) deciding whether to play a TVT chip (Win-Win, Double Pointer, Challenge Chip, Score Lock, Comeback or Underdog) in that GW. The module covers team-facing submission/switch/cancel endpoints, admin force-overrides, and bulk CSV/XLSX imports. It does not handle scoring/processing of those choices (module 05 owns that) nor the league-settings UI (module 02). The Auction format has NO captains/chips — those teams must not be exposed to these endpoints.

userStories.iWant: to announce which of my two players is captain for an upcoming gameweek
userStories.soThat: the scoring engine doubles that player's net FPL score when results come in

userStories.iWant: to switch my captain pick to my other player before the deadline
userStories.soThat: I can react to last-minute team news without being locked in

userStories.iWant: the system to tell me how many captaincy chips a player has remaining for the League Stage
userStories.soThat: I can plan rotation between my two players across the season

userStories.iWant: to submit a TVT chip (W/D/C/SL/CB/UD) for a specific gameweek
userStories.soThat: I can spend my chip allowance for tactical advantage

userStories.iWant: to switch my chip choice to a different chip type for the same gameweek before deadline
userStories.soThat: I can change strategy without burning a chip slot

userStories.iWant: to cancel my chip submission for a gameweek before the deadline
userStories.soThat: I free up that chip in case I want to bank it for a later GW in the set

userStories.iWant: to nominate an opposing-group team when playing the Challenge Chip
userStories.soThat: the chip's cross-group head-to-head bonus is unambiguous at processing time

userStories.iWant: to force-set or correct a team's captain for any gameweek
userStories.soThat: I can fix data-entry mistakes, apply rulings, or backfill missing announcements

userStories.iWant: to override a team's chip state to available / used / wasted for a chip+set with an attached audit reason
userStories.soThat: I can reconcile chip ledgers when the team-facing flow gets out of sync with reality

userStories.iWant: to bulk-import an XLSX/CSV grid of captain picks (one row per team, GW columns marked 'C')
userStories.soThat: I can seed historical captaincy data without 30 manual submissions per team

userStories.iWant: to bulk-import an XLSX/CSV grid of chip picks (W/D/C/SL/CB/UD plus *W wasted-variants and C:OPP opponent abbreviations)
userStories.soThat: I can backfill the season's chip ledger in one operation

userStories.iWant: to clear all chip data (or one GW's chips) before re-importing
userStories.soThat: I can correct large mistakes by wiping and re-uploading instead of patching row-by-row

userStories.iWant: captain and chip announcements to be globally disable-able via league settings
userStories.soThat: I can freeze submissions during processing windows or league reconciliation

userStories.iWant: late captain submissions to be logged as PENALTY audit entries
userStories.soThat: I have an automatic record to apply late-announcement penalties at the end of the GW

userStories.iWant: captain overrides to mark the entry as valid and to log an ADMIN_OVERRIDE audit entry with my reason
userStories.soThat: the player gets full captain points and there is a paper trail for the change

userStories.iWant: the system to refuse Challenge-Chip submissions against a team in my own group
userStories.soThat: the cross-group rule cannot be circumvented even by direct API calls

businessRules.rule: POST /api/team/captain requires a team session (x-session-id header set by middleware after verifying the session cookie); missing session returns 401.
POST /api/team/captain requires both playerId and gameweek; missing either returns 400 with 'playerId and gameweek are required'.

Gameweek number must parse to an integer in [1,38] inclusive; otherwise 400 'Invalid gameweek number (must be 1-38)'. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner — leagues with playoffStartGw=36 only run to GW38 max but other leagues stop sooner; 38 cap is generous.

Captaincy chip-per-player cap depends on league format: Triple Crown leagues allow 19 captaincies per player across GW1..38; all other formats (TVT default) allow 15 captaincies per player across GW1..30. The 'captainCheckLimit' (30 or 38) defines the league-stage horizon used to count chips. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner — captainCheckLimit is hardcoded to 30 for non-TC formats and ignores the league's playoffStartGw, so a TVT league configured with playoffStartGw=36 still uses GW30 as its captaincy horizon.
Selecting a player as captain who is not on the requesting team's roster returns 400 'Player does not belong to your team'.
Gameweek must exist for the requesting team's league (scoped by leagueId); 'GW exists in another league' is not acceptable — returns 404 'Gameweek not found'.
If the league has a 'captainAnnouncementEnabled' setting with value 'false', POST /api/team/captain returns 403 'Captain announcements are currently disabled by the admin'.
Each team has exactly one captain record per gameweek; submitting again UPDATES the existing record (switching player), it does not create a second row.
Submitting the SAME player as the currently-stored captain for that GW returns 400 'This player is already your captain for this gameweek' (no-op rejection).

When counting a player's captaincy-chips-used, the current GW's existing entry is EXCLUDED so that switching back to a previously-captained player does not double-count; only entries on OTHER gameweeks within the league-stage horizon count.
Captain submissions after the gameweek's deadline are still ACCEPTED but flagged isValid=false and a PENALTY audit log is written; the response message includes 'marked as late (after deadline)'.
Captain response payload includes captaincyChipsRemaining: number for league-stage GWs, or the literal string 'unlimited' for playoff GWs (gameweekNumber > captainCheckLimit).
POST /api/team/chips requires gameweek and chipType; chipType must be one of W,D,C,SL,CB,UD (case-sensitive); other values return 400.
Each league has an enabledChips array (default ['D','W','C']) limiting which chip codes may be submitted; submitting a disabled chip returns 400 '<ChipName> is not enabled for this league'.
If the league has a 'chipAnnouncementEnabled' setting with value 'false', POST /api/team/chips returns 403 'Chip announcements are currently disabled by the admin'.
POST /api/team/chips enforces a HARD deadline: if gw.deadline < now the request returns 400 'Deadline has passed for this gameweek' (unlike captains, which accept-with-penalty).
Chips cannot be submitted for playoff gameweeks (gameweek >= league.playoffStartGw); returns 400 'TVT chips cannot be used in playoffs (GW<N>+)'.

Set boundaries are dynamic and derived from league.playoffStartGw: Set 1 = GW1..ceil((playoffStartGw-1)/2), Set 2 = GW(midpoint+1)..(playoffStartGw-1). For default playoffStartGw=31 this yields Set 1 = GW1-15, Set 2 = GW16-30; for playoffStartGw=36 it yields Set 1 = GW1-17, Set 2 = GW18-35.

Each chip type can be used at most once per Set per team, tracked via 12 boolean columns on the teams table (<chip>Set1Used / <chip>Set2Used for W,D,C,SL,CB,UD); attempting to submit a chip whose set-flag is already true returns 400 '<ChipName> has already been used for Set <N> (<range>)'.

When switching chip types within the same GW, the NEW chip type's set-flag must also not be already used; switching from chip X to chip Y where Y's set-flag is true returns 400. The OLD chip type's flag is NOT checked because the old chip is being replaced. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner — the team.set-flag for the OLD chip is never CLEARED on switch, so if the flag was true when the original was submitted via this endpoint it remains true (the flag is only flipped to true on POST insert in admin import / override paths, not the team POST). Investigate whether team-POST sets the flag at all.
Submitting the SAME chipType that is already stored for the same team/GW returns 400 '<ChipName> is already selected for this gameweek' (no-op).
Challenge Chip (chipType='C') REQUIRES a challengedTeamId in the body; missing it returns 400 'Challenge Chip requires selecting an opponent team'.

Challenge Chip's challengedTeamId must reference a team in the OPPOSITE group from the submitting team; same-group challenges return 400 'Challenge Chip can only be used against a team from the opposite group'.
Successful chip switch updates the gameweekChips row in place (same id) and sets updatedAt; response wasSwitched=true.

DELETE /api/team/chips cancels the team's chip submission for a GW; the request must include {gameweek} and only succeeds if the chip row exists and isProcessed=false; after deadline returns 400 'Cannot cancel chip after deadline has passed'.

DELETE /api/team/chips physically removes the gameweekChips row; it does NOT reset the team's <chip>Set<N>Used boolean flag. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner — cancelling a chip leaves the set-flag set if it was ever set, potentially locking the team out of using that chip again in the set.

DELETE /api/team/chips looks up gameweek by gw.number only, NOT scoped to the requesting team's leagueId. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner — in a multi-league deployment two leagues sharing GW number values could pick the wrong row.

All /api/admin/[leagueId]/* routes require an admin or superadmin session AND the session must be authorised for the path's leagueId; unauthenticated returns 401, authenticated-but-not-admin returns 403 'Admin access required', admin-but-wrong-league returns 403 'Forbidden' via getAuthorizedLeagueId.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/override-captain auto-creates a gameweeks row scoped to the league if one does not exist for that GW number (deadline = now + 7*N days at 11:00, isPlayoffs = (N >= playoffStartGw)).

Captain overrides ALWAYS write isValid=true regardless of whether the GW deadline has passed, and write an ADMIN_OVERRIDE audit log with the previous captain name, new captain name, GW, and admin-supplied reason (or 'Not specified').

Captain override verifies the target player belongs to the target team and the target team belongs to the authorized league; cross-team or cross-league assignment returns 400 'Player does not belong to this team' or 404 'Team not found'.

POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/override-chips accepts chipType as one of 12 fully-qualified codes (doublePointerSet1..underdogSet2) and a status of 'available'|'used'|'wasted'; legacy boolean 'used' is accepted for back-compat.

Chip override requires a gameweek parameter when status is 'used' or 'wasted'; gameweek must parse to an integer >= 1 (no upper bound enforced by override). Setting status='available' deletes any matching chip row in the target set without requiring gameweek.

Chip override identifies which existing chip row to replace by 'set' (gwNum<=15 for set1, 15<gwNum<=30 for set2) — these set boundaries are hardcoded and ignore league.playoffStartGw. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner — leagues with non-default playoffStartGw will have override-chips mis-categorize set membership.

Chip override looks up the gameweek row by gw.number only, not scoped to leagueId, and auto-creates one with isPlayoffs=(gwNum>30) if missing. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner — both the unscoped lookup and the hardcoded 30 boundary are wrong for multi-league or non-default playoffStartGw setups.

On chip override, the team's <chip>Set<N>Used flag is set to true for status in {used, wasted}, false for status=available; a new gameweekChips row is written with isProcessed=true, isValid=(status==='used'), hadNegativeHits=(status==='wasted'), pointsAwarded=0.
Every chip override writes an ADMIN_OVERRIDE audit log including chip display name, previous state, new state, team name, and reason (or 'Not specified').

GET /api/admin/[leagueId]/override-chips returns the per-team chip status for only Double Pointer, Challenge Chip, and Win-Win across Set 1 and Set 2 — Score Lock, Comeback, and Underdog are absent from the response payload. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner — the override POST handles all 6 chip types but the GET only shows 3, so admins cannot see SL/CB/UD status in the override UI.
POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/import-captains accepts a JSON body { captains: [{teamId, playerName, '1', '2', ...}] } with at most 500 rows; greater rows return 400 'Too many rows'.

Import-captains resolves teamId case-insensitively against teams.teamLoginId scoped to this league, and resolves playerName case-insensitively against that team's players; unresolved rows are reported in results.errors and do not abort the batch.
Import-captains treats any GW column whose uppercased value is 'C' as a captain marker for that GW; other values (including blank) are ignored.
Import-captains auto-creates missing gameweek rows (per league) with deadline=now+7*N days @ 11:00 and isPlayoffs=(N>=playoffStartGw).

Import-captains is idempotent within a team: if a captain row already exists for the team in that GW and the existing playerId equals the incoming playerId, NO update occurs; if it differs, the row is updated to the new player.

Import-captains increments players.captaincyChipsUsed by 1 for each NEW captain entry inserted (no increment on updates). // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner — there is no overflow check against the 15/19 per-player cap, so import can push a player beyond their format cap.
Import-captains bulk-inserts new entries in a single insert and updates changed ones per-row; on success the response contains created/failed counts plus per-row success and error messages.
POST /api/admin/[leagueId]/import-chips accepts a JSON body { chips: [{teamId, '1', '2', ...}] } with at most 500 rows; columns may use any of: '<N>', 'GW<N>', 'gw<N>', 'Gameweek <N>'.
Import-chips supports six chip markers (W,D,C,SL,CB,UD), six wasted markers (WW,DW,CW,SLW,CBW,UDW), and Challenge-Chip with opponent abbreviation 'C:<TEAMLOGINID>'.
Import-chips C:<OPP> with an unresolved opponent abbreviation does NOT fail the row; the chip is still inserted with challengedTeamId=null and a warning is appended to results.warnings.
Import-chips force-overwrites any pre-existing chip row for the same team+GW (deletes the old row, inserts the new), and appends a warning when the chipType changed.

Import-chips inserts gameweekChips with isProcessed=isWasted, isValid=!isWasted, hadNegativeHits = (isWasted && chipType==='W'); only Win-Win wasted entries flag hadNegativeHits, even though SL/CB/UD also have wasted markers.
Import-chips updates the team's <chip>Set<N>Used flag using getChipSet() (dynamic playoffStartGw boundary) — this is CORRECT, unlike the override-chips endpoint which hardcodes GW15/30 boundaries.

DELETE /api/admin/[leagueId]/import-chips with no query params is scoped to the authorized league: it first selects all gameweek ids where leagueId = current league, then deletes only the gameweekChips rows referencing those ids (via inArray); chips belonging to other leagues are untouched. It then resets ALL 12 set-used columns on the league's teams — doublePointer/challengeChip/winWin/scoreLock/comeback/underdog × Set1+Set2 — to false, and finally calls invalidateLeaguePageCache(leagueId).

DELETE /api/admin/[leagueId]/import-chips with ?gameweek=<N> resolves the gameweek row by AND(gameweeks.number = N, gameweeks.leagueId = current league), so cross-league GW-number collisions cannot select another league's row. If a matching gameweek row exists, all gameweekChips rows referencing that gameweekId are deleted and invalidateLeaguePageCache(leagueId) is called; if no matching row exists for this league, no chips are deleted.
All admin override and import endpoints call invalidateLeaguePageCache(leagueId) after a successful write to flush per-league CDN/page caches.

The Auction format does not use captains or TVT chips: enabledChips/captaincy logic are inherited from the leagues table but auction-tier specific flows do not invoke these endpoints. Auction leagues should hide these UIs and any direct POST is constrained only by the format-agnostic guards above (i.e., the endpoints will still accept calls if the league exists). // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — confirm with product owner — no explicit format='auction' rejection exists; auction teams could theoretically post here.
Triple-Crown captaincy uses captainCheckLimit=38, meaning the per-player 19-captaincy cap applies across all 38 gameweeks (no separate league-stage vs playoff distinction for TC captaincy).

acceptanceCriteria.given: No session cookie is set
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 401 'Not authenticated' from middleware and no DB write occurs

acceptanceCriteria.given: An authenticated team session
acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/team/captain is called with only { playerId } (no gameweek)
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'playerId and gameweek are required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An authenticated team session
acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/team/captain is called with gameweek=0 or gameweek=99
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Invalid gameweek number (must be 1-38)'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A team in a TVT-format league announces its captain in GW15
acceptanceCriteria.when: The chosen player already has 15 league-stage captain entries (excluding GW15)
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 '<playerName> has used all 15 captaincy chips for the League Stage'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A team in a Triple Crown league announces its captain in GW38
acceptanceCriteria.when: The chosen player already has 19 captain entries across GW1..38 (excluding GW38)
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 '<playerName> has used all 19 captaincy chips for the League Stage'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team A is logged in
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team A posts a captain announcement with a playerId belonging to Team B
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Player does not belong to your team'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Two leagues each have a GW7 row in the gameweeks table
acceptanceCriteria.when: A team in league L1 posts a captain for gameweek=7
acceptanceCriteria.then: The system selects the GW7 row whose leagueId = L1.id (not L2's)

acceptanceCriteria.given: Admin has set settings.captainAnnouncementEnabled='false' for the league
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 403 'Captain announcements are currently disabled by the admin' and no captain row is written

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team T has captain=PlayerA for GW10
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team T posts captain=PlayerB for GW10 (their other player)
acceptanceCriteria.then: The existing gameweekCaptains row is UPDATED (same id) with playerId=PlayerB, announcedAt=now, isValid=true (assuming pre-deadline), and response.wasSwitched=true

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team T has captain=PlayerA for GW10
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team T posts captain=PlayerA again for GW10
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'This player is already your captain for this gameweek' and no DB write occurs

acceptanceCriteria.given: PlayerX has been captain for GW10 and is being re-selected for GW10 after a switch-away-and-back
acceptanceCriteria.when: Counting captaincy-chips-used for PlayerX during validation
acceptanceCriteria.then: The current GW10 row is EXCLUDED from the count so the player is not double-charged

acceptanceCriteria.given: GW deadline was 1 hour ago
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team posts captain for that GW
acceptanceCriteria.then: Row is inserted/updated with isValid=false, an auditLogs row of type=PENALTY is written referencing teamId+gameweekId, and the response message contains 'marked as late (after deadline)'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A successful captain submission for GW32 in a league with playoffStartGw=31
acceptanceCriteria.then: captaincyChipsRemaining equals the string 'unlimited'

acceptanceCriteria.given: An authenticated team
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Invalid chipType. Must be one of: W, D, C, SL, CB, UD'

acceptanceCriteria.given: League has enabledChips=['D','W','C']
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Score Lock is not enabled for this league'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Admin has set settings.chipAnnouncementEnabled='false'
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 403 'Chip announcements are currently disabled by the admin'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Gameweek deadline is in the past
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team posts a chip for that GW
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Deadline has passed for this gameweek' and no chip row is created (chips are NOT accepted late, unlike captains)

acceptanceCriteria.given: League playoffStartGw=31
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team posts a chip for GW31
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'TVT chips cannot be used in playoffs (GW31+)'

acceptanceCriteria.given: League playoffStartGw=36 (8-team format)
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team posts a chip for GW18
acceptanceCriteria.then: The submission is treated as Set 2 (midpoint=17, Set 2=GW18-35), and getChipSet(18,36) returns 2

acceptanceCriteria.given: team.winWinSet1Used=true
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Win-Win has already been used for Set 1 (GW1-15)'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team has chipType='W' stored for GW5 and team.doublePointerSet1Used=true
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team switches to chipType='D' for GW5
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Double Pointer has already been used for Set 1 (GW1-15)' (the NEW chip's set-flag is checked)

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team has chipType='W' stored for GW5
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team posts chipType='W' for GW5 again
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Win-Win is already selected for this gameweek'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Authenticated team
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Challenge Chip requires selecting an opponent team'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team T is in Group A, Team U is in Group A
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team T posts Challenge Chip with challengedTeamId=Team U
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Challenge Chip can only be used against a team from the opposite group'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team has chipType='W' stored for GW5
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team switches to chipType='D' for GW5 (and Set 1 D flag is false)
acceptanceCriteria.then: The same gameweekChips row id is reused, chipType is updated to 'D', updatedAt is set, response.chip.wasSwitched=true

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team has an unprocessed chip submission for GW5 and now < deadline
acceptanceCriteria.then: The chip row is removed and response is 200 with 'Chip cancelled for GW5'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team has a chip submission for GW5 and now >= deadline
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Cannot cancel chip after deadline has passed' and the row remains

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team has used W chip for GW5 (winWinSet1Used=true)
acceptanceCriteria.when: Team DELETEs that chip, then posts chipType='W' for GW10
acceptanceCriteria.then: The DELETE removes the row but winWinSet1Used remains true, so the second post returns 400 'Win-Win has already been used for Set 1' (defect)

acceptanceCriteria.given: A logged-in team-session (not admin) cookie
acceptanceCriteria.then: Middleware returns 403 'Admin access required'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Admin authorised for league L1
acceptanceCriteria.then: getAuthorizedLeagueId returns null and the response is 403 'Forbidden'

acceptanceCriteria.given: League L has no gameweeks row for GW40
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Invalid gameweek number (must be 1-38)' (the 1..38 guard runs before the auto-create)

acceptanceCriteria.given: League L has no gameweeks row for GW35 but it is within 1..38
acceptanceCriteria.then: A new gameweeks row is inserted with leagueId=L.id, number=35, deadline=now+7*35 days @ 11:00, isPlayoffs=(35 >= playoffStartGw)

acceptanceCriteria.given: GW20 deadline has passed
acceptanceCriteria.when: Admin overrides captain for that GW
acceptanceCriteria.then: The captain row is written with isValid=true and an auditLogs entry of type=ADMIN_OVERRIDE is created including the reason from the request body (or 'Not specified')

acceptanceCriteria.given: Admin posts override-captain with a playerId whose team!=teamId-in-body
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Player does not belong to this team'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Admin posts override-chips with chipType='doublePointerSet1' and no status field
acceptanceCriteria.then: Backward-compat branch maps used=true to status='used' and the operation proceeds

acceptanceCriteria.given: Admin posts override-chips with status='used' but no gameweek
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Gameweek is required when setting status to used or wasted'

acceptanceCriteria.given: Admin posts override-chips status='wasted', chipType='winWinSet1', gameweek=8
acceptanceCriteria.then: team.winWinSet1Used=true, a new gameweekChips row is written with isProcessed=true, isValid=false, hadNegativeHits=true, pointsAwarded=0, and an ADMIN_OVERRIDE audit log is written

acceptanceCriteria.given: League playoffStartGw=36 (Set 2 should be GW18-35)
acceptanceCriteria.when: Admin posts override-chips for chipType='doublePointerSet2', gameweek=20
acceptanceCriteria.then: The set-membership filter chipsInSet uses gwNum>15 && gwNum<=30, so an existing GW20 D chip is correctly matched, but a GW33 D chip (also Set 2 under playoffStartGw=36) would NOT be matched (defect)

acceptanceCriteria.given: Two leagues each own a GW20 row
acceptanceCriteria.when: Admin of league L1 posts override-chips status='used', gameweek=20
acceptanceCriteria.then: The code looks up gameweeks WHERE number=20 (no leagueId filter), potentially writing the chip row against league L2's gameweekId (defect)

acceptanceCriteria.given: Admin GETs /api/admin/[leagueId]/override-chips
acceptanceCriteria.then: Each team's chips object contains only set1.{doublePointer,challengeChip,winWin} and set2.{doublePointer,challengeChip,winWin}; scoreLock, comeback, underdog are absent (defect)

acceptanceCriteria.given: 501 captain rows in the request body
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Too many rows. Maximum 500 captain entries per upload.'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A captain row has teamId='TEAM-A' (mixed case)
acceptanceCriteria.then: The team lookup is case-insensitive against teams.teamLoginId and resolves to the correct team

acceptanceCriteria.given: A captain row's GW column value is 'X' (not 'C')
acceptanceCriteria.then: No captain entry is created for that GW; no error is logged

acceptanceCriteria.given: Import captains references GW25 but no gameweek row exists
acceptanceCriteria.then: A new gameweek row is auto-created with leagueId scoped to this league

acceptanceCriteria.given: An existing captain row {gw=10, playerId=A}
acceptanceCriteria.when: Import-captains brings a row for {team, GW10, playerName=B (same team's other player)}
acceptanceCriteria.then: The existing row is updated to playerId=B and players.captaincyChipsUsed is NOT re-incremented

acceptanceCriteria.given: Import-captains inserts a brand-new captain entry for PlayerA in GW10
acceptanceCriteria.then: players.captaincyChipsUsed is incremented by 1 for PlayerA (no cap check)

acceptanceCriteria.given: Import-chips body contains 501 chip rows
acceptanceCriteria.then: Response is 400 'Too many rows. Maximum 500 chip entries per upload.'

acceptanceCriteria.given: A row has cell value 'C:TAD' for GW7
acceptanceCriteria.then: A Challenge Chip row is inserted with challengedTeamId=lookup('TAD').id; if TAD does not exist, challengedTeamId=null and results.warnings includes an opponent-not-found message

acceptanceCriteria.given: A row has cell 'SLW' for GW8
acceptanceCriteria.then: A Score-Lock chip is inserted with isProcessed=true, isValid=false, hadNegativeHits=false (W-only flag), and a 'marked as WASTED' warning is added

acceptanceCriteria.given: Team had a 'W' chip for GW6 and import brings 'D' for GW6
acceptanceCriteria.then: The pre-existing chip is DELETED, the new 'D' row is INSERTED, and results.warnings includes 'replaced W chip with D'

acceptanceCriteria.given: League playoffStartGw=36 and import-chips inserts a 'D' for GW17
acceptanceCriteria.then: team.doublePointerSet1Used is set to true (getChipSet(17,36)=1) — the import endpoint uses dynamic boundaries correctly

acceptanceCriteria.given: League L1 has 200 gameweekChips rows (with SL/CB/UD Set1+Set2 flags set on some L1 teams) and league L2 has 100 gameweekChips rows
acceptanceCriteria.when: Admin of L1 calls DELETE /api/admin/L1/import-chips with no query string
acceptanceCriteria.then: Only L1's 200 chip rows are deleted (L2's 100 remain intact), and all 12 set-used columns (W/D/C/SL/CB/UD × Set1+Set2) are reset to false on every team in L1; L2's team flags are untouched and invalidateLeaguePageCache(L1) is called

acceptanceCriteria.given: Two leagues L1 and L2 each have a GW5 row in the gameweeks table, each with their own gameweekChips rows
acceptanceCriteria.then: The gameweek lookup is AND(number=5, leagueId=L1), so only L1's GW5 row is selected and only L1's GW5 chips are deleted; L2's GW5 chips remain intact and invalidateLeaguePageCache(L1) is called

acceptanceCriteria.given: Any successful admin override or import write
acceptanceCriteria.then: invalidateLeaguePageCache(leagueId) is called before the response is returned

acceptanceCriteria.given: An Auction-format league (format='auction')
acceptanceCriteria.when: A team in that league posts /api/team/captain or /api/team/chips
acceptanceCriteria.then: The endpoint executes the normal captain/chip flow with no auction-specific rejection (defect — see BR-CHIP-055)

acceptanceCriteria.given: A Triple-Crown league with playoffStartGw=37
acceptanceCriteria.then: Since gameweekNumber (31) <= captainCheckLimit (38), the 19-per-player cap check IS applied

testCases.scenario: POST /api/team/captain without a session returns 401
testCases.preconditions: No session cookie set; no x-session-id header forwarded by middleware

defects.title: DELETE /api/team/chips looks up gameweek by number only, not scoped to leagueId
defects.description: src/app/api/team/chips/route.ts:292-298 queries gameweeks WHERE number = gameweekNumber with no leagueId filter. In a multi-league deployment two leagues will each have their own GW row sharing the same 'number' value, so this query can return the wrong league's gameweek row and the subsequent chip lookup/delete will operate on the wrong league's data (or simply fail because no chip exists for the requesting team in the foreign GW).
defects.expectedBehaviour: Look up gameweek by (number AND leagueId = team.leagueId), matching the pattern used by POST /api/team/chips (route.ts:92-95).
defects.actualBehaviour: Cross-league gameweek collision possible; team may be told 'No chip submission found' even when it has one for its own league's GW with the same number.
defects.notes: Fix: add eq(gameweeks.leagueId, team.leagueId) to the where clause. Need to first fetch the team (currently the DELETE handler doesn't load the team at all). Low risk; small change.

defects.title: DELETE /api/team/chips does not reset the team's set-used flag
defects.description: When a team cancels a chip submission before deadline, src/app/api/team/chips/route.ts:325-326 deletes the gameweekChips row but never clears the corresponding team.<chip>Set<N>Used boolean. Today the team POST handler does NOT flip the flag to true on submission either (only admin import/override do), so the bug may be latent for the team flow specifically — but if a future fix sets the flag on submission, cancel-and-resubmit will be silently broken. Inconsistency between submission and cancellation is itself a defect.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Either (a) the team submission flow does set the flag and the DELETE clears it, or (b) the flag is only managed by admin/import flows and the team flow uses an alternate mechanism. The two must agree.
defects.actualBehaviour: Today the team-facing POST relies on the set-used flag being false (lines 136-147) to allow submission, but never sets it — the flag is only flipped by import and override. If the flag is set by some other path, cancellation cannot reverse it, locking the team out of that chip in the set.
defects.notes: Investigate whether POST /api/team/chips intends to set the flag (a missing UPDATE teams ... set <col>=true). Decide product behaviour first; the schema design suggests the flag should track 'used in this set', which means POST should set true and DELETE should set false.

defects.title: override-chips set-membership filter hardcodes GW15/30 boundaries
defects.description: src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/override-chips/route.ts:178-181 filters chipsInSet by 'gwNum <= 15' for set1 and 'gwNum > 15 && gwNum <= 30' for set2. These boundaries are hardcoded and ignore the league's playoffStartGw. For an 8-team league (playoffStartGw=36) Set 1 is actually GW1-17 and Set 2 GW18-35; this filter will fail to match existing chip rows in GW16-17 (mis-categorised as Set 2) and GW31-35 (excluded entirely).
defects.expectedBehaviour: Use getChipSet(gwNum, league.playoffStartGw) === setNumber to compute set membership, matching the rest of the codebase.
defects.actualBehaviour: Override may insert a duplicate chip row rather than replacing the existing one, leaving stale chip data on non-default playoffStartGw leagues.
defects.notes: Same fix as DEF-CHIP-006. Replace the inline gwNum<=15 check with getChipSet().

defects.title: override-chips gameweek lookup is not scoped to leagueId
defects.description: src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/override-chips/route.ts:193-211 queries gameweeks WHERE number = gwNum with no leagueId filter. In a multi-league deployment, this may return another league's GW row, and the subsequent chip insert will reference a foreign gameweekId. The auto-create branch uses isPlayoffs=(gwNum > 30) which is also hardcoded.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Look up gameweek by (number AND leagueId), and on auto-create compute isPlayoffs from league.playoffStartGw (matching override-captain at lines 42-48).
defects.actualBehaviour: Override may write chip records against the wrong league's gameweek; in single-league dev environments this is masked.
defects.notes: Add eq(gameweeks.leagueId, leagueId); read playoffStartGw from leagues table before the insert.

defects.title: override-chips GET response omits Score Lock, Comeback, Underdog chips
defects.description: src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/override-chips/route.ts:311-372 (GET handler) returns each team's chip status with only doublePointer, challengeChip, winWin in each of set1/set2. The teams table has columns and the POST handler accepts overrides for scoreLock/comeback/underdog, but the admin UI cannot see their state because the GET payload omits them entirely.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Return all 6 chips per set, gated by league.enabledChips (so leagues that didn't enable SL/CB/UD don't show them).
defects.actualBehaviour: Admin override page can never display or correct SL/CB/UD state for a team.
defects.notes: Extend the per-team chips object with scoreLock, comeback, underdog (mirroring the W/D/C entries) and ensure the chipTypes list includes them. Also extend chipGwLookup keys (currently only D1/W1/C1/etc.).

defects.title: import-chips DELETE wipes ALL leagues' chips and ignores SL/CB/UD flags
defects.description: src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/import-chips/route.ts:375-385: the unscoped DELETE branch calls db.delete(gameweekChips) with NO WHERE clause, deleting every chip row across every league. The subsequent teams flag reset is scoped to leagueId (correct) but only resets doublePointerSet1/2Used, challengeChipSet1/2Used, winWinSet1/2Used — leaving scoreLockSet1/2Used, comebackSet1/2Used, underdogSet1/2Used set if they were previously true. Same problem in the per-GW branch: line 363 looks up the gameweek by number with no leagueId scope.
defects.expectedBehaviour: DELETE should scope chip deletion to gameweekChips referencing gameweeks where leagueId = current league. The teams flag reset should clear all 12 set-used flags (W/D/C/SL/CB/UD × Set1/Set2).
defects.actualBehaviour: Calling the bulk-clear endpoint silently destroys chip data in every other league sharing the database; SL/CB/UD set-used flags remain set, blocking those chips from being re-imported correctly.
defects.notes: Highest-priority fix in this module. Use a subquery: DELETE FROM gameweekChips WHERE gameweekId IN (SELECT id FROM gameweeks WHERE leagueId = ?). Add the 6 missing flags to the reset object. Same fix for the per-GW branch (filter by leagueId). [DEV] Self-verified: tsc passes for touched file (only pre-existing unrelated tests/league-types/* errors remain), manual diff review clean. Awaiting QA re-run of pinningTestCases. [QA] Re-run TC-CHIP-071 and TC-CHIP-072 against the fix. Expected behaviour now matches the original 'expectedBehaviour' field: bulk DELETE only wipes chips referencing gameweeks in the current league and resets all 12 set-used columns; ?gameweek=N DELETE only matches the gameweek row scoped to the current league. [BA] BR-CHIP-052 and BR-CHIP-053 now describe defective behaviour that has been corrected — update the rule text (and AC-CHIP-052 / AC-CHIP-053) to reflect the league-scoped DELETE and 12-flag reset. [QA-VERIFIED]: 2026-05-25 — TC-CHIP-071 + TC-CHIP-072 inverted; cross-league wipe + full flag reset confirmed. [BA-UPDATED]: 2026-05-25 — BR-CHIP-052, BR-CHIP-053, AC-CHIP-052, AC-CHIP-053.
defects.resolution: Fixed in src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/import-chips/route.ts DELETE handler. (1) Bulk branch (no query param) now selects gameweek ids for the authorized league and deletes gameweekChips via inArray(gameweekChips.gameweekId, leagueGameweekIds) instead of an unscoped db.delete(gameweekChips). (2) The teams flag reset now clears all 12 set-used columns (W/D/C/SL/CB/UD × Set1/Set2) instead of only W/D/C. (3) Per-GW branch (?gameweek=N) now looks up the gameweek row by AND(number, leagueId), so cross-league GW-number collisions can no longer target the wrong league's data. Added inArray to the drizzle-orm import.

defects.title: Captain captainCheckLimit hardcoded to 30 for non-Triple-Crown leagues, ignoring playoffStartGw
defects.description: src/app/api/team/captain/route.ts:53 sets captainCheckLimit = 30 for any league whose format is not 'triple-crown'. For an 8-team TVT league (playoffStartGw=36, league stage = GW1-35), captaincies in GW31-35 will be treated as playoff captaincies with 'unlimited' chips remaining, when they are actually still in the league stage and should count toward the 15-per-player cap.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Derive captainCheckLimit from league.playoffStartGw - 1 (so 30 for default, 35 for 8-team format).
defects.actualBehaviour: TVT 8-team leagues (and any league with playoffStartGw != 31) compute captaincy chip remaining incorrectly during GW(playoffStartGw-1) down to GW31.
defects.notes: Read leagues.playoffStartGw alongside format and compute captainCheckLimit = playoffStartGw - 1. Coordinate with module 05 to confirm what 'League Stage' means in the captaincy cap.

defects.title: Auction-format leagues are not blocked from captain/chip endpoints
defects.description: Per project spec, the Auction format has no captains or TVT chips. However neither /api/team/captain nor /api/team/chips checks league.format; an auction team that knows the endpoint URLs could POST and the system would create captaincy rows and chip rows in tables that the auction processor ignores.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Reject with 400 'Captains/Chips are not available in Auction-format leagues' when team.league.format === 'auction'.
defects.actualBehaviour: Endpoint accepts the call, may write rows that are functionally dead but pollute the audit log and player.captaincyChipsUsed counters.
defects.notes: Add an early-return guard after fetching league.format. Low effort, defence-in-depth.

defects.title: import-captains has no per-player captaincy-cap overflow check
defects.description: src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/import-captains/route.ts:186-188 and 210-215 increment players.captaincyChipsUsed by 1 per new captain entry, but do not check whether the player already has 15 (TVT) or 19 (TC) entries in the league stage. The team-facing POST enforces this cap (route.ts:104-122) but the import bypasses it.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Either reject overflow rows with a per-row error in results.errors, or warn in results.warnings, or count entries pre-flight per player.
defects.actualBehaviour: An import file with 20 'C' marks against a single player in GW1-20 in a TVT league silently succeeds and over-counts captaincyChipsUsed.
defects.notes: Admin import is intentionally authoritative ('skip validation'), so a strict reject may be too aggressive — a warning may be the right product call.

defects.title: import-chips only flags Win-Win as hadNegativeHits when wasted; other wasted chips do not set the flag
defects.description: src/app/api/admin/[leagueId]/import-chips/route.ts:223 sets hadNegativeHits = (isWasted && chipType==='W'). This means importing SLW/CBW/UDW marks the chip isValid=false but does not set hadNegativeHits=true, so the override-chips GET handler's wasted detection (which uses (isProcessed && !isValid) || hadNegativeHits, line 307) still correctly identifies them as wasted, but downstream consumers that rely solely on hadNegativeHits will miss them.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Either set hadNegativeHits=true for any wasted chip (consistent with the override semantic at override-chips:222), or rename the column to something chip-agnostic to clarify W-only intent.
defects.actualBehaviour: Inconsistent waste-marker semantics between import-chips (W-only) and override-chips (any chip).
defects.notes: Confirm column semantics with product. If hadNegativeHits is intended Win-Win-specific (i.e., 'team took negative transfer hits'), then override-chips is the wrong endpoint and import-chips is correct.
